links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT reliability across three repeated attempts
links.effect: GPT-4 showed significant variability in reliability across three attempts (P = .007); GPT-4o mini and GPT-4o showed no significant differences.
links.quote: GPT-4 demonstrated significant variability in reliability across the three attempts (P = .007).

links.outcome: Overconfidence: high confidence scores assigned to incorrect answers
links.effect: Overconfidence percentage was 100% (22 of 22) for GPT-4o and 22.7% (10 of 44) for GPT-4o mini (P < .01).
links.quote: Furthermore, the overconfidence percentage (confidence score of ≥8 assigned to incorrect answers) was 100% (22 of 22) for GPT-4o and 22.7% (10 of 44) for GPT-4o mini, respectively (P < .01).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the reliability, repeatability, and confidence of multiple versions of ChatGPT against guideline recommendations for interstitial lung disease without evaluating a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
